description: NaInAs₂O₇ crystallizes in the monoclinic C2/c space group. Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.33-2.56 Å. In is bonded to six O atoms to form InO₆ octahedra that share corners with six AsO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of In-O bond distances ranging from 2.13-2.18 Å. There are two inequivalent As sites. In the first As site, As is bonded to four O atoms to form AsO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with three equivalent InO₆ octahedra and  a cornercorner with one AsO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 45-55°. There are a spread of As-O bond distances ranging from 1.66-1.78 Å. In the second As site, As is bonded to four O atoms to form AsO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with three equivalent InO₆ octahedra and  a cornercorner with one AsO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 47-58°. There are a spread of As-O bond distances ranging from 1.67-1.76 Å. There are seven inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one In, and one As atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to one Na, one In, and one As atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to one Na, one In, and one As atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to one Na, one In, and one As atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to one Na, one In, and one As atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a bent 120 degrees geometry to two As atoms. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 150 degrees geometry to one In and one As atom.
